needed.evidence: No paved or continuous footway; only a narrow dirt/grass verge exists between the road and the grassy area.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved footway of at least 1.5 m width along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking surface.

needed.evidence: No dedicated footway exists; the area beside the road is unpaved and occupied by stalls and debris.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved footway of at least 1.5 m width along the right side of the road, relocating the roadside stalls to a designated market area.

needed.evidence: Roadside stalls, goods and a motorcycle are obstructing the narrow strip beside the road.
needed.suggestion: Enforce a no-obstruction zone and relocate the informal roadside stalls to a purpose-built market area away from the road.

needed.evidence: The unpaved ground beside the road is uneven with visible debris and a low concrete barrier that creates trip risks.
needed.suggestion: Grade and pave the right-side verge to create a smooth, continuous walking surface free of debris and barriers.

needed.evidence: A pedestrian is walking in the carriageway and people are present on both sides of the road, but there is no marked or physical crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked pedestrian crossing at this location to provide a designated safe place for people to cross.

needed.evidence: There are no kerbs or ramps at any crossing point as no formal crossing exists.
needed.suggestion: Construct footways with dropped kerbs at the new crossing point to ensure safe access for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No street lights are visible along this stretch of road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users during the night.
